doc: The same young cyclone (age 0.25) with float64 directions: the gaussians are float64 and only the final weight is cast to float32, so the output is float32 rounded from float64 (up to a float32 ulp of rounding). Tolerance rtol 1e-5, atol 1e-6 (the default): the output is float32, so a float64 nudge of the inputs changes nothing (0 observed) and the other float64 order (reversed vortices, one cast at the end of an all-float64 accumulation) differs by at most 2.4e-7 (0.03 of the band). Conventions of cloudgen.sphere read here: lonlat_to_dir(lon, lat) = (cos lat cos lon, cos lat sin lon, sin lat) with float64 numpy cos and sin (right-handed, z north, longitude grows east; a vortex center is that direction); normalize(v) = v / |v| (plain division, no epsilon: a zero vector gives NaN).

params.dtype_chain: p float64: d2, exp, the comma head and the eye are float64 per vortex; each vortex term is cast to float32 and accumulated in float32, in vortex order (float64 math per vortex, float32 accumulation). The output is float32.
